annotations.title: Get brand kit from a website

description: Reads a business's public website and returns its name, a colour palette (with where each colour was found; colours read from the logo are the most reliable, and website-builder default colours are filtered out), logo and icon image URLs, a hero image, a guess at the type of business, and a suggested starting card design built from those. Works without a Leal account. Use the result to propose card designs with preview_card_designs.

intent.description: Optional. One short sentence on what the person asked you to do, e.g. "Set up a stamp card for Ground Up Café". Leal shows it in the person's activity log under Settings → AI agents, so they can see what was done for them. Leave out customer details.

url.description: The business's website, e.g. https://beanthere.coffee or beanthere.coffee.

name: get_brand_kit
title: Get brand kit from a website
